test_title: PYST 67: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

It is high time you **must go home**.
solution:
The correct answer is '**went home**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• The phrase "**went home**" uses the past tense form of the verb "**go**." 
 
• The expression "**It is high time**" implies the action should have already been completed, requiring the past tense.
